name: Temple Zone of Sambor Prei Kuk, Archaeological Site of Ancient Ishanapura
description: Deep in the forests of Kampong Thom Province, Sambor Prei Kuk was Ishanapura, capital of the Chenla kingdom some 1,400 years ago. Over a hundred brick temples lie scattered among the trees, ten of them octagonal, a shape found nowhere else in South-East Asia. Roots wrap around crumbling towers, and carved sandstone lintels hint at the style that later flowered at Angkor.
